To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have investigated the Mott effect for heavy quarkonium due to Debye screening of the heavy quarks in a quark plasma.
we have shown the Mott dissociations of the quarkonia states in a plasma of light massless quarks.
the Mott dissoci-ation temperatures for the quarkonia ground states are about 200 MeV for the charmonium and 250 MeV for the bottomonium states.

the study of the quarkonium dissociation temperatures within a model of the quark-gluon plasma, which is described by the Polyakov loop extended Nambu-Jona-Lasinio (PNJL) model.
the study of quarkonia in hot medium and the Mott e ects.
the study of the properties of the quark–gluon plasma (QGP).

the quarkonium dissociation temperature is a very sensitive function of the quark mass, and it increases as the mass of the quark decreases.
